+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(source: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Read inline images or objects from the configured storage bucket."""
+    if not source:
+        return None
+    try:
+        if source.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, payload = source.split(",", 1)
+            if header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(payload, validate=True)
+            return None
+
+        url = urlsplit(source)
+        key = source
+        if url.scheme or url.netloc:
+            if url.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+                return None
+            base = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST)
+            prefix = base.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if (url.scheme != base.scheme or url.netloc.lower() != base.netloc.lower()
+                    or not url.path.startswith(prefix)):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(url.path[len(prefix):])
+        if "\\" in key or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        # Missing objects and malformed images are skipped by image consumers.
+        return None

@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+from fastapi import HTTPException
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.api.v1.endpoints.episodes import export_episode
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def sources():
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (1, 1)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+    png = buf.getvalue()
+    key = storage.upload_image(png, "cuts", "test")
+    return png, [key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}",
+                 "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode()]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    send = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("unexpected HTTP request"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "send", send)
+    yield
+    send.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def export_paths(paths, fmt):
+    session = Mock()
+    session.get.return_value = SimpleNamespace(deleted_at=None, title="Panels")
+    session.exec.return_value.all.return_value = [
+        SimpleNamespace(image_path=path, cut_order=i) for i, path in enumerate(paths, start=7)
+    ]
+    return export_episode(session=session, episode_id=1, format=fmt, current_user_id="test")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("partial", [False, True])
+def test_export_reports_omitted_cuts(sources, no_http, fmt, partial):
+    png, paths = sources
+    if partial:
+        paths.extend([None, "http://internal.invalid/image", "absent.png", "data:image/png;base64,YQ=="])
+    response = export_paths(paths, fmt)
+    if partial:
+        assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "10,11,12,13"
+    else:
+        assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in response.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+            names = [f"Panels_{i:02d}.png" for i in range(7, 10)]
+            assert archive.namelist() == names + (["missing.txt"] if partial else [])
+            assert all(archive.read(name) == png for name in names)
+            if partial:
+                assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"10\n11\n12\n13\n"
+
+
+def test_all_cuts_missing(no_http):
+    response = export_paths([None], "zip")
+    assert response.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "7"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.body)) as archive:
+        assert archive.namelist() == ["missing.txt"]
+        assert archive.read("missing.txt") == b"7\n"
+    with pytest.raises(HTTPException) as error:
+        export_paths([None], "webtoon")
+    assert error.value.status_code == 400
+    assert error.value.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "7"
+
+
+def test_ai_and_reference_board_image_sources(sources, no_http):
+    png, paths = sources
+    ai = BaseAIService()
+    for path in paths:
+        assert ai._download_image(path) == png
+        assert download_image(path).size == (1, 1)
+    for path in ("http://internal.invalid/image", "//internal.invalid/image",
+                 f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}.other/image"):
+        assert ai._download_image(path) is None
+        assert download_image(path) is None
